name: Reverse String
instructions:
# Instructions

Your task is to reverse a given string.

Some examples:

- Turn `"stressed"` into `"desserts"`.
- Turn `"strops"` into `"sports"`.
- Turn `"racecar"` into `"racecar"`.
introduction:
# Introduction

Reversing strings (reading them from right to left, rather than from left to right) is a surprisingly common task in programming.

For example, in bioinformatics, reversing the sequence of DNA or RNA strings is often important for various analyses, such as finding complementary strands or identifying palindromic sequences that have biological significance.
starter_code:
(defmodule reverse-string
    (export (reverse 1)))

; Please implement the exported function(s).
example_solution:
(defmodule reverse
  (export (string 1)))

(defun string (str)
  (let ((reversed (string:reverse (iolist_to_binary str))))
    (binary_to_list
      (if (is_binary reversed)
          reversed
          (unicode:characters_to_binary reversed)))))
test_code:
(defmodule reverse-string-tests
  (behaviour ltest-unit)
  (export all))

(include-lib "ltest/include/ltest-macros.lfe")

(deftest reverses-empty-string
  (is-equal ""
            (reverse:string "")))

(deftest reverses-a-word
  (is-equal "tobor"
            (reverse:string "robot")))

(deftest reverses-a-capitalized-word
  (is-equal "nemaR"
            (reverse:string "Ramen")))

(deftest reverses-a-palindrome
  (is-equal "racecar"
            (reverse:string "racecar")))

(deftest reverses-an-even-sized-word
  (is-equal "reward"
            (reverse:string "drawer")))
